title: One Plan, Managed by Inquiry
description: AuraFlux self-serve plan vs Managed inquiry and fair-use limits.
author: AuraFlux
body_html:
AuraFlux operates on a focused, single-tier self-serve structure designed specifically for media teams, high-volume creators, and growth agencies.

The $999/mo Self-Serve Plan

Our core plan provides complete access to the clip generation pipeline for a single active brand. You get automated stream peak detection, portal-driven Short production, and direct publishing workflow tools out of the box.

  • Peak Detection: Automated tracking for YouTube Most Replayed data, Twitch chat velocity, and CCV spikes.
  • Short Production: Spec-driven portals for vertical reframing, captioning, brand, and QA — only the stages your job needs.
  • Multi-Platform Publishing: Direct push to YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.

Managed Production & API Access

Managed Inquiries & Enterprise API
